characters.background: 富三代，刻意低调，怕被人知道家里有钱
characters.appearance: 东亚少年，短黑发略乱未打理，五官普通偏柔和，下颌线较软，眼神温和略疲惫
characters.costume: 米白色宽松连帽卫衣（胸口小刺绣标），浅蓝水洗直筒牛仔裤，白色运动鞋，整体干净朴素
characters.negative: 破旧衣服, 补丁, 开胶旧鞋, 裂屏手机, 脏污, 廉价配饰
characters.sourcePrompt: young East Asian male lead, ordinary everyday looks, plain handsome-average face, slightly soft jawline, unstyled short black hair, tired but kind eyes, light acne or uneven skin texture ok, casual campus/office clothes (simple hoodie or plain shirt and jeans), understated, not glamorous, not idol-like

characters.background: 富三代，刻意低调；被系统改造后外貌明显变帅，仍是同一个人
characters.appearance: 同一张脸的升级版：下颌线清晰，皮肤干净，眼神深邃自信，短黑发整齐上梳造型，身形修长匀称
characters.costume: 米白色翻领拉链短夹克，白色圆领T恤，黑色修身直筒长裤，白色运动鞋
characters.negative: 破旧衣服, 旧球鞋, 裂屏手机, 牛仔外套, 换成另一个演员的脸
characters.sourcePrompt: same young East Asian male lead as the ordinary version but transformed: sharper jawline, clearer skin, deeper eyes, neat styled short black hair, confident calm expression, proportional athletic-slim build, well-fitted modern casual outfit (clean shirt or light jacket), polished but still the same person identity, idol-adjacent handsomeness, not a different actor

characters.background: 贫困家庭出身的校草，校服偏旧偏小，和白朴是对窗邻居
characters.appearance: 东亚少年，窄脸，深色中长刘海略乱遮眉，神情冷静略带倔强，高瘦，和白朴明显不是同一张脸
characters.costume: 蓝白配色高中运动校服：白色拉链外套配蓝色插肩袖与双白条、左胸校徽；蓝色运动裤外侧双白条；白色旧帆布鞋，鞋头有磨损；袖口略短
characters.negative: 名牌西装, 高领毛衣, 皮鞋, 金表, 昂贵配饰, 崭新名牌运动鞋, 白朴同款脸
characters.sourcePrompt: 17-year-old East Asian male second lead, poor-family school heartthrob, strikingly handsome natural face clearly different from the protagonist: narrower face, slightly longer messy fringe falling over the brows, calm cool slightly defiant gaze, tall lean build, wearing a faded and slightly too-small Chinese high school tracksuit uniform (blue-white zip jacket and matching track pants), sleeves a bit short at the wrist, fabric washed-out and pilled but clean and neatly worn, old canvas sneakers with worn toes, no jewelry, no accessories, empty hands
